title: 4 Keys Keyboard
statement: Given an array of integers and a target sum `K`, find the length of the longest sub-array whose elements sum up to `K`. If no such sub-array exists, return 0. The sub-array must be contiguous and non-empty. For example, given the array `[1, 4, 20, 3, 10, 5]` and `K = 33`, the longest sub-array with sum `K` is `[20, 3, 10]`, so the function should return `3`. If the array is empty or `K` is not a valid sum, the function should return `0`. The input array will contain only integers and will not be null.
